lines = old_songs_content.strip().split('\n')
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('#') or not line:
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artists_str = line.split(' by ', 1)
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        old_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
